title.zh: 有限网格 FRC 反馈组合

summary: Run fixed finite-grid FRC Green boundary, inner pressure/current and coil feedback with explicit convergence state.

capability: Run fixed finite-grid FRC Green boundary, inner pressure/current and coil feedback with explicit convergence state.
operation: finite FRC inputs -> psi, pressure, current, boundary and three-layer diagnostics
discovery.boundary: Declared finite input and typed failure contract

identity.relation: finite FRC inputs -> psi, pressure, current, boundary and three-layer diagnostics
identity.boundary: No hidden defaults or source checkout dependencies
assumptions: Caller supplies complete finite typed inputs

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.constraints: Finite fields and declared model controls.

preconditions: Inputs satisfy the declared finite model contract
supported: Run fixed finite-grid FRC Green boundary, inner pressure/current and coil feedback with explicit convergence state.
excluded: Unspecified source models and hidden runtime state

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for malformed or nonfinite inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Propagates numerical failures without fabricated output.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Returns declared bounded nonconvergence state when applicable.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result on validation failure.

example.code:
from scirel.equilibrium import solve_finite_frc_feedback
result=solve_finite_frc_feedback(inputs)
assert "converged" in result

verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded public composition evidence; scientific acceptance remains separate.
known_limitations: No external physical validation or release approval is implied.
